argv_file_header: # KPF-18 gate argv (production :8083 argv minus binary/--port, plus the -b 512 -ub 512 + --no-cache-idle-slots
# package named in kv-prefix-fork-and-paged-attention.md). The runner adds --port, --metrics,
# --slot-fork-min-tokens and its own --slot-save-path; item 4 adds the prefill-budget args.
# launch prefix in that record: numactl --membind=3 -- taskset -c 184-191
# production binary in that record: /mnt/raid0/llm/kernels/builds/gpu-20260921-ffc1bac82/bin/llama-server (NOT used here; the runner takes --fork-bin/--champion-bin)
# changes vs the record: removed --port 8083; -ub 2048 -> -b 512 -ub 512; added --no-cache-idle-slots

slot_fork_from_launch_log: cross-slot prefix fork enabled: mode = checkpoint, min tokens = 1024, cache_idle_slots = 0
equivalence_basis: First-token top-k probabilities from /completion `n_probs` (completion_probabilities, post_sampling_probs false = softmax over the full vocabulary before sampling). The server cannot return full logits, so `logit_maxabs` is max |p_a - p_b| over the UNION of the two top-k sets (an id absent from one side counts as 0 there: an upper bound) and `kld` is KL(a||b) over the top-k union plus one tail bucket, absent ids imputed from that side's tail mass capped at its k-th prob (a coarse-grained KL: a lower bound on the full-vocab KL when the imputation is exact). Greedy-prefix length compares returned token ids over n_predict tokens (ignore_eos). `identical` = all token ids AND every per-position top-k entry equal.
unique_cells_method: max llamacpp:kv_cells_used sampled once after each request (a lower bound of the true peak; item 7 polls at 1 Hz instead)

decode_tok_s.aggregate_method: sum predicted_n / sum predicted_ms over this run's requests (token-weighted mean decode rate; requests are sequential, not a concurrent aggregate)

grading_note: n=1 per cell, no codified protocol cited: an OBSERVATION; projects under VB-KVU-PF and grades Judged/Located through claim_tuple.grade(). Counts, not a pass word.
predeclared_rule: 18.3 part 4 localisation, g5 P = trunk 60000 + suffix0: source slot 0 (checkpoint_at [T]); child slot 1 fork (residents {0}); erase 1, coldE slot 1 cache_prompt false checkpoint_at [T] (residents {0}); erase 1, child2 slot 1 fork (residents {0}); coldA slot 2 (residents {0,1}); coldB slot 3 (residents {0,1,2}); erase 1-3, decoy slot 1 = g6 trunk cut to len(P)+K-1 (LCP with P < fork-min), childX slot 2 fork (residents {0,1}). Position i = kpf18_s1r.tf_arm. d = mean |dlp| over positions valid in child, child2, coldA, coldB, coldE. floor = d(coldA,coldB) lifted to 1e-4; cold_max = max d over the 3 cold pairs; dFF = d(child,child2); dCE = d(child,coldE). INVALID iff a judged arm fails its validity (timings or residents); ABSTAIN iff < 16 common or len(P) < 50000; FORK_PATH_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE iff dFF > 0; OCCUPANCY_NUMERICS iff dCE <= floor; FORK_PATH_SPECIFIC iff dCE > cold_max; BETWEEN_FLOOR_AND_COLD_SPREAD otherwise. childX (2x2 reading) and the cross-load reading vs R3 have zero weight. Forced sequence sha256 ec9ad963c7482f6d703e6077ddced625d17c884a67f0fc5c80677c65c1296865

controls.manifest: prompt_set_sha256 + binary_sha256 + argv (read back from /proc and the launch log) are in this record; per-sibling raw cells (n_fork_tokens from timings and from /slots, prediction, checkpoint sets, errors) are under `cells`
controls.baseline: the fork-off arm (--slot-fork-min-tokens 0) of the same command on the same binary, and champion tip e33229348 (item 6 / KPF-18.0b)
controls.held_out: lengths or prompts used to SET a rule are never used to judge it (arm D holdout cell; arm C/D positions come from the server's own checkpoint offsets, not from fitted numbers)
controls.counted: every sibling is a cell, including errors, aborts and abstentions
controls.reported_as: counts under rule_result; no pass word
